title: Only What You Came For
lessons: a purchase can be practical rather than expressive
price is information, not a verdict

text: My list fits on the back of an old receipt. Five things.
Every aisle has thirty versions of each one. I only need one.
Nobody's watching the cart but me. That's the point.

choices.text: Buy what's on the list. Leave the rest.
Grab one extra thing and make a dinner worth taking my time on.

text: Receipt's shorter than the aisle wanted it to be.
Still got my evening. Still got my five things.
One thing off the list turns into dinner.
Not an upgrade. Just a plan that smells good.
